newsitem.title: USA: PepsiCo to end pact with Ocean Spray - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: PepsiCo to end pact with Ocean Spray - WSJ.

text.p: PepsiCo Inc intends to ends it agreement next year to distribute Ocean Spray drinks, the Wall Street Journal said.
In Monday's electronic edition, the Journal said the move may portend PepsiCo's desire to develop and market its own line of juice drinks.
A PepsiCo spokesman said the company has notified Ocean Spray Cranberries Inc, a growers' cooperative based in Massachusetts, that it will not renew its contract.
The contract, which expires in May, allows Pepsi's bottling operations to distribute Ocean Spray.
This "gives us flexibility to develop our own juice products," a Pepsi spokesman said.
